messages:
anna: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can folks drop short notes here about recent customer wins and losses (why we won/lost) and the most common asks you keep hearing. Leadership wants a condensed list for the roadmap sync tomorrow. Please be concise.

mike: Win: Fintech pilot signed last week. Why we won: predictable latency + easy sandboxing. Loss: large retail RFP — lost to vendor with deeper integration into their data pipeline. Top ask I hear: native connector for Snowflake / Redshift.

sophie: From product POV — recurring asks: (1) better rollout controls for model versioning; (2) built-in evals tied to deploys; (3) finer cost-estimation per-route.

kevin: Lost one POC -> model-compatibility mismatch (customer insisted on 8-bit quantized variant we didn't have). Reason: no quick quantization profile generator.

raj: Support notes: wins often come from fast onboarding and proactive playbooks. Losses are usually due to missing compliance docs or slow legal turnaround. Ask: a concise compliance pack (SOC2 + data residency checklist) we can share.

lisa: Solutions engineering: repeatable demo templates + canonical prompts helped close 3 deals. Customers ask for example prompt sets per vertical (SaaS, ecommerce, finance). Also ask for SDK snippets in Go/Rust, not just Python/TS.

oliver: Quick leadership clarifications: we'll prioritize (A) compliance pack, (B) Snowflake connector exploration, (C) quantization profile tooling. But help me triage: which of these is highest ROI this quarter?

mike: ROI vote = 1) compliance pack, 2) Snowflake connector, 3) quant-profiles. Compliance unblocks pipeline deals.

sophie: Product vote = 1) quant profiles (reduces infra ops for customers), 2) rollout controls, 3) connector. But we can ship a lightweight compliance doc fast.

kevin: Technical note: quant profile generator is nontrivial — needs perf infra + a small search. Could we scope an MVP that seeds profiles for top 5 models?

oliver: Sounds reasonable. MVP scope: automated calibration for 3 model families + docs.

raj: For the compliance pack, I'll draft a 1-pager and a checklist this week. ping @anna if we need exec signoff for statement of use.

anna: Thanks — team, please keep updates short. Action items: mike/lisa consolidate top 10 asks from sales/solutions by EOD. raj to deliver compliance 1-pager by Thu. kevin/sophie to draft quant MVP scope by Fri. I'll surface to execs at roadmap sync. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: roadmap-sync-docs v2 -> production at 2025-09-15 18:00 UTC (no downtime expected).

mike: Noted. Also flag: customers keep asking about price/commit flexibility (monthly vs annual committed). Small ask but frequent.

sophie: Adding that to the list. Also request from GA customers — better telemetry for per-inference costs (token-level breakdown).

lisa: I'll attach two anonymized win/loss summaries to the jira ticket after this thread.

anna: Great. If anyone else has one-line additions, drop them here before EOD. We'll keep this thread as the single source for tomorrow's sync. :raised_hands:
